name: straightedge
description: Tell your agent how the diagram should look. Layout control for Mermaid.
author: Greg Jennings

scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:docs && npm run test:package
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:e2e

comments.pinned: mermaid, elkjs, and puppeteer are pinned exactly on purpose. The layout-loader API is public but young, LayoutData is semi-internal, and Chromium changes can affect visual baselines; treat an upgrade as a deliberate task, not a dependabot merge.
comments.deps: Seven package dependencies, including Node declarations required by the public .d.ts surface. If this list grows, ask why.
